geometry: Full-profile weighted-median motion height, five-frame smoothing inherited; mm positive above bar
colour: Linear black to red, 5th to 95th percentiles of jointly valid scores; outside colours saturated. Each segment uses mean score of its two endpoints. Colour saturation only; numerical trace values unchanged. No extra smoothing.
missing: No segment across invalid endpoints. Slip markers and stop shading omitted.
interpretation: Motion location, not anatomical stationary tail position; negative score values are retained from baseline normalization.
